page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.gn5 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 8 vCPUs, providing a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio without hyperthreading. The instance is equipped with 60.0 GB of system memory, translating to 7.5 GB of RAM per core.

This server integrates dedicated hardware accelerators, featuring two NVIDIA P100 GPUs with a combined total of 32 GB of VRAM. Additionally, local storage is bundled directly with the instance, providing 944 GB of SSD capacity. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Given the inclusion of dual enterprise-grade GPUs and local SSD storage, this instance offers a specialized hardware profile for workloads requiring parallel processing and fast local disk access. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable compute performance. It is suited for workloads such as GPU-accelerated database operations, deep learning inference, scientific simulations, and data processing tasks that benefit from local SSD caching and multi-GPU configurations.
